description: Validates documentation Markdown, Mermaid, links, references, and manifests through knowledge-observatory.

capabilities.label: Documentation Contract
capabilities.description: Scenario documentation target resolution, manifest schema, and contract metadata validity.

levels.name: Contract unresolved
levels.description: Knowledge Observatory cannot trust the scenario documentation contract.
entry_criteria: A scenario or documentation path was selected
exit_criteria: The target resolves to a readable documentation contract
levels.capability_summary: Documentation contract cannot be resolved or trusted.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve the scenario docs manifest or source-template fallback contract.

levels.name: Contract discoverable
levels.description: A documentation contract is readable, but schema or required metadata may still be incomplete.
entry_criteria: A manifest or fallback contract is readable
exit_criteria: Manifest schema, kind, schema id, stage, maturity, and document metadata validate
levels.capability_summary: Contract input is present but not yet fully valid.
levels.next_unlock: Make the docs manifest and all contract metadata schema-valid.

levels.name: Contract valid with fallback tolerance
levels.description: Contract metadata is valid; any remaining findings are fallback or advisory contract posture.
exit_criteria: Scenario-owned manifest is present and contract findings are clean
levels.capability_summary: Contract metadata validates with only advisory posture left.
levels.next_unlock: Own the docs contract directly in the scenario manifest without fallback warnings.

levels.name: Contract clean
levels.description: Documentation contract and schema are clean enough for delegated docs health.
exit_criteria: Contract stays clean during Test Genie delegation
levels.capability_summary: Documentation contract is valid and scenario-owned.

capabilities.label: Required Documentation
capabilities.description: Required, missing, misplaced, extra, and temporary documentation placement.

levels.name: Required docs blocked
levels.description: Required documentation cannot be found at contract-approved paths.
entry_criteria: The documentation contract identifies required docs
exit_criteria: Required docs exist and are not misplaced
levels.capability_summary: Required documentation is missing or misplaced.
levels.next_unlock: Create required docs and move misplaced docs to their contract paths.

levels.name: Required docs present
levels.description: Required docs exist, but placement hygiene may still have temporary or extra artifacts.
exit_criteria: No extra or temporary docs remain
levels.capability_summary: Required docs are present with placement hygiene still to resolve.
levels.next_unlock: Retire temporary docs and register or remove extra docs.

levels.name: Placement managed
levels.description: Required documentation placement is managed and low-noise.
exit_criteria: Placement stays clean across scenario changes
levels.capability_summary: Documentation placement is managed.
levels.next_unlock: Keep placement clean as the scenario evolves.

levels.name: Placement clean
levels.description: Required docs are present, correctly placed, and free of temporary or extra artifacts.
exit_criteria: Placement remains clean during provider validation
levels.capability_summary: Required documentation is present and correctly placed.

capabilities.label: Append-Log Integrity
capabilities.description: Append-log heading, field, date-source, and format contract validity.

levels.name: Append-log contract blocked
levels.description: Append-log operations cannot be applied safely.
exit_criteria: Append-log target heading, fields, date source, and format validate
levels.capability_summary: Append-log configuration is invalid.
levels.next_unlock: Fix append-log heading, fields, date source, and format declarations.

levels.name: Append-log contract valid
levels.description: Append-log operations are structurally valid.
exit_criteria: Append-log operations remain valid as docs evolve
levels.capability_summary: Append-log declarations validate.
levels.next_unlock: Keep append-log contracts synchronized with their target documents.

levels.name: Append-log managed
levels.description: Append-log contracts are managed and ready for automated doc entries.
exit_criteria: Append-log contracts remain clean during resets and additions
levels.capability_summary: Append-log operations are safe to use.
levels.next_unlock: Retain clean append-log contracts during maintenance workflows.

levels.name: Append-log clean
levels.description: Append-log integrity is clean.
exit_criteria: Append-log validation remains clean
levels.capability_summary: Append-log integrity is clean.

capabilities.label: Content Quality
capabilities.description: Markdown, Mermaid, absolute paths, file reads, content issues, and derived-number markers.

levels.name: Content unreadable
levels.description: Documentation content cannot be read or parsed reliably.
exit_criteria: Files are readable and markdown structure is not broken
levels.capability_summary: Documentation content is unreadable or structurally broken.
levels.next_unlock: Fix file read errors and broken markdown structure.

levels.name: Content readable
levels.description: Documentation content is readable, but quality findings remain.
exit_criteria: Markdown, Mermaid, absolute-path, and number-marker findings are resolved
levels.capability_summary: Content is readable with quality findings still present.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve markdown, Mermaid, absolute-path, and derived-number findings.

levels.name: Content managed
levels.description: Documentation content is healthy enough for operator and agent use.
exit_criteria: Content quality remains clean across doc changes
levels.capability_summary: Content quality checks are managed.
levels.next_unlock: Keep content quality clean as documentation changes.

levels.name: Content advisory-ready
levels.description: Documentation content has no maturity-blocking content findings; advisory debt remains visible separately.
exit_criteria: Content health remains clean in delegated validation
levels.capability_summary: Documentation content has no maturity-blocking findings.

capabilities.label: Link Health
capabilities.description: Local link parsing, broken local links, and external link warnings or failures.

levels.name: Links blocked
levels.description: Documentation links cannot be trusted.
exit_criteria: Broken local links and parse failures are resolved
levels.capability_summary: Local link integrity is broken.
levels.next_unlock: Fix local link parse failures and broken local targets.

levels.name: Local links healthy
levels.description: Local links are healthy; external link posture may still be advisory.
exit_criteria: External link warnings are triaged or resolved
levels.capability_summary: Local links are healthy with external-link findings still possible.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve or triage external link warnings and failures.

levels.name: Links managed
levels.description: Local and external link health is managed.
entry_criteria: Link findings are resolved or intentionally advisory
exit_criteria: Link health remains clean across docs changes
levels.capability_summary: Link health is managed.
levels.next_unlock: Keep link health clean during documentation updates.

levels.name: Links clean
levels.description: Documentation links are clean.
exit_criteria: Link validation remains clean
levels.capability_summary: Documentation links are clean.

capabilities.label: Reference Integrity
capabilities.description: [CODE:], // DOC:, marked machine-readable references, CLI refs, and command snippet validation.

levels.name: References broken
levels.description: Code/doc or marked references are broken enough to mislead agents.
entry_criteria: References are discovered in docs or code
exit_criteria: Broken code, doc, marked, CLI, and command references are resolved
levels.capability_summary: Documentation references are broken.
levels.next_unlock: Fix broken code/doc references, marked refs, CLI refs, and command snippets.

levels.name: References resolvable
levels.description: Hard reference failures are resolved; partial or unknown validation may remain.
exit_criteria: Partial and unknown reference validations are triaged or resolved
levels.capability_summary: References are mostly resolvable with validation gaps still present.
levels.next_unlock: Resolve partial and unknown marked-reference or command-snippet validation.

levels.name: References managed
levels.description: References are healthy enough to support code/documentation traceability.
entry_criteria: Reference-integrity findings are resolved or intentionally advisory
exit_criteria: References remain healthy as code and docs move
levels.capability_summary: Reference integrity is managed.
levels.next_unlock: Keep references synchronized with code and command surfaces.

levels.name: References advisory-ready
levels.description: Code, doc, marked, CLI, and command snippet references have no maturity-blocking findings; advisory debt remains visible separately.
exit_criteria: Reference checks remain clean in delegated validation
levels.capability_summary: Reference integrity has no maturity-blocking findings.

capabilities.label: Manifest Coverage
capabilities.description: docs/manifest.json coverage of the markdown documentation set.

levels.name: Manifest coverage blocked
levels.description: Required docs are missing from the manifest coverage model.
exit_criteria: Docs required by the manifest are present
levels.capability_summary: Manifest coverage is missing required docs.
levels.next_unlock: Add missing docs or correct manifest registrations.

levels.name: Manifest coverage present
levels.description: Manifest-required docs are present; orphaned docs may still be unregistered.
exit_criteria: No orphaned markdown docs remain
levels.capability_summary: Manifest coverage is present with orphaned docs still possible.
levels.next_unlock: Register orphaned docs or remove obsolete files.

levels.name: Manifest coverage managed
levels.description: Manifest coverage is managed across the markdown set.
exit_criteria: Manifest coverage stays clean as docs change
levels.capability_summary: Manifest coverage is managed.
levels.next_unlock: Keep docs/manifest.json synchronized with markdown changes.

levels.name: Manifest coverage clean
levels.description: The manifest covers the documentation set cleanly.
exit_criteria: Manifest coverage remains clean
levels.capability_summary: Manifest coverage is clean.

contract_missing.reason: Resolving a missing documentation contract requires choosing the correct manifest or template source of truth.

schema_load_error.reason: Schema load failures require inspecting the local schema and manifest paths before editing docs.

schema_violation.reason: Schema violations require deciding the correct contract metadata for the scenario.

manifest_missing.reason: Creating a missing docs manifest requires selecting scenario-owned documentation structure.

scenario_manifest_missing.reason: Promoting from template fallback to a scenario manifest requires scenario ownership decisions.

invalid_contract_kind.reason: The correct contract kind is a source-of-truth metadata decision.

invalid_contract_schema.reason: The correct contract schema version must match the manifest semantics.

missing_maturity_values.reason: Maturity values define scenario documentation policy and require human intent.

missing_stages.reason: Stage definitions encode scenario lifecycle policy and require human intent.

duplicate_identifier.reason: Resolving duplicate identifiers requires choosing canonical document ids.

invalid_maturity.reason: Correct maturity classification depends on the document's role.

invalid_required_by.reason: Correct required-by stages depend on scenario lifecycle policy.

missing_section_id.reason: Section ids must be chosen to preserve stable documentation navigation.

missing_section_title.reason: Section titles require human-readable navigation wording.

missing_document_path.reason: Document paths require choosing the correct durable location.

missing_doc_type.reason: Document type depends on the document's intended audience and role.

missing_document_title.reason: Document titles require human-readable navigation wording.

missing_maturity.reason: Document maturity depends on the document's role in the scenario.

missing_required_by.reason: Required-by metadata depends on scenario lifecycle policy.

missing_completion.reason: Completion metadata requires deciding whether a doc is required, conditional, or optional.

invalid_completion.reason: Correct completion metadata depends on the document's contract role.

append_log_missing_heading.reason: Append-log target headings must match the document structure chosen by humans.

append_log_invalid_fields.reason: Append-log fields define durable entry shape and require contract intent.

append_log_invalid_date_source.reason: Append-log date-source behavior must match the chosen entry format.

append_log_invalid_format.reason: Append-log formats are contract decisions and cannot be inferred safely.

missing_doc.reason: Creating missing documentation requires scenario-specific content judgment.

extra_doc.reason: Extra docs require deciding whether to register, move, merge, or delete content.

temporary_doc.reason: Temporary docs require deciding whether the content should be promoted or removed.

content_issue.reason: Content issues require choosing the correct durable documentation wording.

file_read_error.reason: File read failures require inspecting filesystem state and intended document ownership.

markdown_unclosed_fence.reason: Closing a markdown fence safely requires understanding the intended fenced content.

mermaid_invalid.reason: Invalid Mermaid diagrams require choosing the correct diagram semantics.

absolute_path.reason: Absolute paths require deciding the correct portable reference or source-of-truth link.

unmarked_number.reason: Derived numbers require deciding whether to remove, tag, or replace with a source-of-truth reference.

number_marker_without_reason.reason: Number markers need human-owned rationale for why the number is stable enough to keep.

broken_link_parse.reason: Malformed links require preserving the intended target while correcting syntax.

broken_local_link.reason: Broken local links require choosing whether to update, restore, or remove the target.

external_link_warning.reason: External link warnings require deciding whether the source remains authoritative.

broken_external_link.reason: Broken external links require finding a durable replacement or removing the reference.

broken_code_ref.reason: Broken code references require choosing the correct implementation target or retiring stale prose.

broken_doc_ref.reason: Broken doc references require choosing the correct durable documentation target.

broken_marked_ref.reason: Broken marked references require preserving typed reference intent while correcting the target.

unknown_marked_ref.reason: Unknown marked references require deciding whether to register a marker or rewrite the reference.

unknown_cli_ref.reason: Unknown CLI refs require deciding whether the command is real, renamed, or intentionally illustrative.

partial_cli_ref.reason: Partial CLI refs require deciding whether stricter command validation is required.

unknown_command_snippet.reason: Unknown command snippets require deciding whether to update the command, narrow validation, or keep prose-only guidance.

partial_command_snippet.reason: Partial command snippets require deciding whether argument-level validation is needed.

broken_command_snippet.reason: Broken command snippets require choosing the correct current command invocation.

manifest_missing_doc.reason: Missing manifest docs require deciding whether to create the document or correct manifest coverage.

manifest_orphaned_doc.reason: Orphaned docs require deciding whether to register, move, merge, or delete content.

determinism.reason: Provider inputs and external observations are not proven to be completely represented by a file digest.
